propositions: Provider construction logic is currently scattered across inline branches in runner.py:268, requiring surgery on the hottest function for each new provider (Bedrock, OpenAI-compatible) instead of registering them in a central place

Client teardown (httpx.AsyncClient) has no clean lifecycle hook in pydantic-ai's infer_model provider_factory signature, so retrying clients are manually tracked and closed in runner.py:446-452 finally blocks

ProviderSession as a context manager solves both: it owns a provider_factory callable matching pydantic-ai's hook contract, maintains a registry of builders, and manages closeable resources through __enter__/__exit__

Anthropic builder moves from runner.py inline code into a registered builder in providers.py, preserving all existing behavior (tenacity transport, max_retries=0, per-request timeout, loopback-proxy bypass)
Import sites of _build_retrying_anthropic_model must move from rebar.llm.runner to rebar.llm.anthropic_model to eliminate circular dependency and maintain providers.py as a leaf module

After run() returns or raises, all httpx.AsyncClient instances opened by the session must be verified closed on the real client object, and unknown provider names must raise LLMConfigError listing registered providers instead of KeyError
